description: Find specific trim variants of a known make+model compatible with a given HF tyre size. Required: overall_diameter (inches), section_width (INCHES), rim_diameter (inches), make, model. Optional: region, limit, offset.

make.description: Manufacturer slug (e.g. "ford", "ram"). Get slugs from list-makes.

model.description: Model slug (e.g. "f-150", "1500"). Get slugs from list-models.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

overall_diameter.description: Overall outside diameter of the inflated tyre in inches (e.g. 33.0). Required. Must be positive. Part of the HF size notation: OD x SW R RD (e.g. 33x12.5R15).

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "usdm", "eudm"). Get codes from list-regions.

rim_diameter.description: Rim diameter in inches (e.g. 15). Required. Must be positive. Use list-hf-tire-rim-diameters to enumerate valid values.

section_width.description: Tyre section width in INCHES (e.g. 12.5). Required. Must be positive. Note: this differs from standard by_tire tools where section_width is in mm.

name: search-modifications-by-hf-tire
